question: Compare the 2025 average completed order value of Enterprise and SMB customers. If Enterprise's is more than 20% higher than SMB's, break down Enterprise's 2025 completed revenue by product category; otherwise, break down SMB's 2025 completed revenue by product category.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS completed_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment = CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price * (1 - oi2.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) FROM orders AS o2 JOIN customers AS c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'completed' AND o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c2.segment = 'Enterprise') > 1.2 * (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price * (1 - oi2.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) FROM orders AS o2 JOIN customers AS c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'completed' AND o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c2.segment = 'SMB') THEN 'Enterprise' ELSE 'SMB' END GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY completed_revenue DESC LIMIT 500
